faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answer your main questions before booking.

items.question: What is personal financial consulting?
items.answer: Individual sessions focused on organizing your finances, setting goals, and building a practical plan — always educational and guidance-oriented.

items.question: What is the difference between consulting and courses?
items.answer: Consulting is personalized with Carolyne. Courses and digital materials let you learn at your own pace with structured content.

items.question: Do I need prior financial knowledge?
items.answer: No. Sessions are adapted to your level, from basics to advanced. What matters is willingness to look at your reality honestly.

items.question: How do I book a session?
items.answer: Create an account, choose a package and available time slot. Carolyne confirms the booking and sends a meeting link if needed.

items.question: Does the AI assistant replace consulting?
items.answer: No. The assistant provides general educational content. For personalized guidance, book a consulting session.

items.question: Is this investment advice?
items.answer: No. All content is educational and does not constitute individualized investment advice.
